title: Guest Review Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Airbnb bookings (`airbnb:booking`), Vrbo reservations (`vrbo:reservation`), Airbnb payouts (`airbnb:payout`), and guest reviews (`guest:review`).
app: Airbnb booking exports, Vrbo reservation webhooks, Airbnb payout statements, guest review logs, and turnover checklists streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=guest:review
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(listing_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many guest review events land each day and how many distinct listing values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest guest review records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct listing values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how much guest review activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
